item.title: Police investigating fatal shooting on Convention Street
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Homicide detectives with the Baton Rouge Police Department are investigating a fatal shooting that occurred on Convention Street Saturday night.&nbsp;According to the department, officers arrived around 11:10 p.m. to find Gregory Lee, 31, on the front porch of a home suffering from a gunshot wound. Lee was pronounced dead at the scene.&nbsp;The investigation remains ongoing.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Maurepas home catches fire, investigators say unattended pot was left on stove
item.description: MAUREPAS - An unattended pot left on a stove started a house fire in Maurepas on Sunday.&nbsp;The fire happened at a home along Picou Lane around 9:20 a.m. Volunteer firefighters from Maurepas, Springfield and French Settlement worked to put out the blaze.&nbsp;Photos shared by Livingston Parish Fire Dist. 9 showed a large hole in the roof of the house. It is a total loss.&nbsp;Fire officials said no injuries to people were reported, but the family's pet passed away in the fire.&nbsp;Permalink|

item.title: Vacant home along Government Street catches fire, signs of squatters found
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A vacant home along Government Street near Park Boulevard caught fire Sunday evening.&nbsp;Baton Rouge Firefighters put out the fire, which was contained to the home's living room, but the rest of the house sustained damage from smoke and water.&nbsp;Fire officials didn't list a cause, but said there were signs of squatters around the property.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
